:::{#exr-se-rmse-unbiased}
#### Standard error of an unbiased estimator

Using @eq-unbiased-mse,
write the [standard error](#def-SE) of an [unbiased](#def-unbiased) estimator $\hth$
in terms of its [mean squared error](#def-mse).
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-se-rmse-unbiased}

By @eq-unbiased-mse, $\mselr{\hth} = \Var{\hth}$.
Taking square roots of both sides,
$\sqrt{\mselr{\hth}} = \SD{\hth} = \SE{\hth}$.

:::
